56e35707661212e9b415.en: Editing improves meaning and style. Proofreading corrects mistakes.
56e35707661212e9b415.id: Editing memperbaiki makna dan gaya tulisan. Proofreading membetulkan kesalahan.

b83b0af27e73d8722c0e.en: Check that verbs agree with their subjects and that tenses stay consistent.
b83b0af27e73d8722c0e.id: Periksa apakah verb sudah cocok dengan subjeknya dan apakah tense tetap sama.

febf6ad1a42b0275ed63.en: Watch out for commonly confused words.
febf6ad1a42b0275ed63.id: Hati-hati dengan kata yang sering tertukar.

66f4746c2663012b633e.en: Make sure every sentence is complete and every opening phrase clearly describes its subject.
66f4746c2663012b633e.id: Pastikan setiap kalimat lengkap dan setiap frasa pembuka jelas menerangkan subjeknya.

f8208f0b8de5acacac54.en: Replace repeated or vague words with precise details.
f8208f0b8de5acacac54.id: Ganti kata yang berulang atau kurang jelas dengan rincian yang tepat.

670b2087167a3220e33a.en: Cars can be counted, so we use fewer, and cars is plural, so we use are.
670b2087167a3220e33a.id: Cars bisa dihitung, jadi kita memakai fewer, dan cars berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi kita memakai are.

53e4b72ff205cc3a65c9.en: Cars can be counted, so use fewer.
53e4b72ff205cc3a65c9.id: Cars bisa dihitung, jadi pakai fewer.

87c37b91274baadaa0ae.en: Cars is plural, so use are.
87c37b91274baadaa0ae.id: Cars berbentuk jamak, jadi pakai are.

009d1dcc37e1f0a417de.en: Fewest is used to compare three or more things.
009d1dcc37e1f0a417de.id: Fewest dipakai untuk membandingkan tiga benda atau lebih.

cbe47ae4b19177c21251.en: Accommodation has a double c and a double m: ac-com-mo-da-tion.
cbe47ae4b19177c21251.id: Accommodation punya dua huruf c dan dua huruf m: ac-com-mo-da-tion.

7da525e44cb950dd5f05.en: Necessary has one c and two s, like a shirt with one collar and two sleeves.
7da525e44cb950dd5f05.id: Necessary punya satu c dan dua s, seperti kemeja dengan satu collar (kerah) dan dua sleeves (lengan).

396f1589cefc75205a06.en: Necessary has one c, not two.
396f1589cefc75205a06.id: Necessary punya satu c, bukan dua.

e32a36cbbf70b04440fd.en: Necessary has a c after the first e.
e32a36cbbf70b04440fd.id: Necessary punya c setelah e pertama.

0a63c5c0901b537dae8e.en: Its shows that the tail belongs to the dog. It’s always means it is or it has.
0a63c5c0901b537dae8e.id: Its menunjukkan bahwa ekor itu milik anjing itu. It’s selalu berarti it is atau it has.

c1440afea12960243647.en: It’s means it is. The dog wagged it is tail does not make sense.
c1440afea12960243647.id: It’s berarti it is. The dog wagged it is tail tidak masuk akal.

453f3638f324b404a9ea.en: It’s means it is, and the dogs are plural.
453f3638f324b404a9ea.id: It’s berarti it is, dan the dogs berbentuk jamak.

958b3fecb44fb70847c6.en: Definitely contains the word finite: de-finite-ly.

f127f09fb2583c19cf61.en: Because the bus was late and Although it rained are subordinate clauses with no main clause. Running along the beach has no subject.
f127f09fb2583c19cf61.id: Because the bus was late dan Although it rained adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause) tanpa induk kalimat. Running along the beach tidak punya subjek.

5f85839c31b0909cd164.en: Pupils can be counted, so we use fewer. Pupils is plural, so the verb is are.
5f85839c31b0909cd164.id: Pupils bisa dihitung, jadi kita memakai fewer. Pupils berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi kata kerjanya are.

06502a3aac70eff7cea5.en: Use fewer with things you can count, such as pupils.
06502a3aac70eff7cea5.id: Pakai fewer untuk benda yang bisa dihitung, seperti pupils.

4960e475f6a3d8c8b977.en: Lesser means not as important, not a smaller number.
4960e475f6a3d8c8b977.id: Lesser berarti kurang penting, bukan jumlah yang lebih kecil.

d3af1866c38fb6011bf4.en: Pupils is plural, so the verb should be are.
d3af1866c38fb6011bf4.id: Pupils berbentuk jamak, jadi kata kerjanya seharusnya are.

e7cf446d37211996ec9b.en: Each is singular, so it takes has: Each of the pupils has a locker.
e7cf446d37211996ec9b.id: Each berbentuk tunggal (singular), jadi memakai has: Each of the pupils has a locker.

8484142707d9ed7ba4ac.en: The subject is each, which is singular.
8484142707d9ed7ba4ac.id: Subjeknya adalah each, yang berbentuk tunggal.

0326041dccc0b179c5d8.en: After each of, the noun should be plural: pupils.
0326041dccc0b179c5d8.id: Setelah each of, kata bendanya harus jamak: pupils.

9394423002ed8dc53248.id: Kalimat ini tidak punya kata kerja utama.

3c9350c0522bd8def9ce.en: Whole means all of the class, and their shows the teamwork belongs to the class.
3c9350c0522bd8def9ce.id: Whole berarti seluruh kelas, dan their menunjukkan bahwa kerja sama itu milik kelas itu.

1221ba7532cf4eacc39b.en: The text is about last week, so visit should be visited. Seen needs a helping verb, so the simple past saw is correct here.
1221ba7532cf4eacc39b.id: Teks itu tentang last week, jadi visit seharusnya visited. Seen memerlukan kata kerja bantu (helping verb), jadi simple past saw yang benar di sini.

e054244d2bc9c88a48eb.en: Bogor is the name of a city, so it needs a capital letter.
e054244d2bc9c88a48eb.id: Bogor adalah nama kota, jadi memerlukan huruf kapital.

b10305b80542627711b4.en: The trip is in the past, so enjoyed is correct.
b10305b80542627711b4.id: Perjalanan itu terjadi pada masa lampau, jadi enjoyed sudah benar.

fadbb4bbdedb95cf17db.en: Everyone is correct here as the subject.
fadbb4bbdedb95cf17db.id: Di sini Everyone sudah benar sebagai subjek.

98d31961eb5d22885c8e.en: The best edit keeps beautiful once and adds precise details, golden and clear turquoise, instead of repeating it.
98d31961eb5d22885c8e.id: Perbaikan terbaik memakai beautiful satu kali dan menambahkan rincian yang tepat, yaitu golden dan clear turquoise, tanpa mengulang kata itu.

9ab3eeebfbc211550c66.en: This still repeats beautiful three times.
9ab3eeebfbc211550c66.id: Ini masih mengulang beautiful tiga kali.

e00f2bbd34e52c2b800a.en: This swaps one repeated word for another.
e00f2bbd34e52c2b800a.id: Ini menukar satu kata yang berulang dengan kata berulang lainnya.

396f51ed3f8138fee2d9.en: This is not a complete sentence.

f82c4dec3fe82743b5c3.en: In the correct sentence, it is clear that I was walking and I saw the rainbow. In the others, the opening phrase seems to describe the rainbow.
f82c4dec3fe82743b5c3.id: Pada kalimat yang benar, jelas bahwa I yang berjalan dan I yang melihat the rainbow. Pada kalimat lainnya, bagian pembuka seolah menerangkan the rainbow.

b630f0500bdb2ceba6f5.en: This sounds as if the rainbow was walking to school.
b630f0500bdb2ceba6f5.id: Kalimat ini terdengar seolah-olah the rainbow yang berjalan ke sekolah.

4d2be7c04ac4bdca85a9.en: This sounds as if the rainbow was walking.
4d2be7c04ac4bdca85a9.id: Kalimat ini terdengar seolah-olah the rainbow yang berjalan.

b5045d9cc82004389fc6.en: Rainbows cannot see, and this sounds as if the rainbow was walking.
b5045d9cc82004389fc6.id: Pelangi tidak bisa melihat, dan kalimat ini terdengar seolah-olah the rainbow yang berjalan.

4f51a3085f9d172b23b3.en: A sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop, and the day name Monday also needs a capital letter.
4f51a3085f9d172b23b3.id: Kalimat dimulai dengan huruf kapital (capital letter) dan diakhiri dengan titik (full stop), dan nama hari Monday juga memerlukan huruf kapital.

7305f0abd72410d9b10d.en: Days of the week begin with a capital letter.

a7a97f1bf71a6ba6319c.en: A question needs a question mark, and this is meant as a statement.
a7a97f1bf71a6ba6319c.id: Pertanyaan memerlukan tanda tanya, dan kalimat ini dimaksudkan sebagai pernyataan.

e8981f302e5c7b3874a8.en: Children does not end in s, so we add apostrophe s: children’s.
e8981f302e5c7b3874a8.id: Children tidak berakhiran s, jadi kita menambahkan apostrophe s: children’s.

e92b1b8fb9963f5c00ff.en: Children is already plural, so the apostrophe goes before the s.
e92b1b8fb9963f5c00ff.id: Children sudah berbentuk jamak, jadi apostrof berada sebelum s.

dd603039a512690dc2a8.en: They’re means they are, their shows that the books belong to them, and there shows a place.
dd603039a512690dc2a8.id: They’re berarti they are, their menunjukkan bahwa buku-buku itu milik mereka, dan there menunjukkan tempat.

2a893c75ba12e95be9e0.en: Recieved and beutiful are misspelt. A question needs a question mark, and speech needs speech marks and a capital letter. She don’t and they was use the wrong verb forms.
2a893c75ba12e95be9e0.id: Recieved dan beutiful salah ejaan. Kalimat tanya memerlukan tanda tanya (question mark), dan ucapan memerlukan tanda petik (speech marks) dan huruf kapital. She don’t dan they was memakai bentuk kata kerja yang salah.

570c7d7fc582b66b2f22.en: After has, we use the past participle. The past participle of give is given.
570c7d7fc582b66b2f22.id: Setelah has, kita memakai past participle. Past participle dari give adalah given.

b6def6f3c1d32abf7e26.en: Last week tells us the past, so the verb is visited. The cards visit and weeks do not fit.
b6def6f3c1d32abf7e26.id: Last week menunjukkan masa lalu, jadi kata kerjanya visited. Kartu visit dan weeks tidak cocok.

9d125682aab1b6b535a5.en: Two complete sentences usually need a full stop or a joining word. A comma plus so fixes the run-on sentence.
9d125682aab1b6b535a5.id: Dua kalimat lengkap biasanya memerlukan titik (full stop) atau kata penghubung. Koma ditambah so memperbaiki run-on sentence itu.

bab74435ec43a477019a.en: A comma alone cannot join two full sentences.
bab74435ec43a477019a.id: Koma saja tidak bisa menyambung dua kalimat lengkap.

c6b5ff731aadbb06de98.en: The comma is in the wrong place.
c6b5ff731aadbb06de98.id: Komanya ada di tempat yang salah.

f1a7b296e1de4514808f.en: The comma comes in the wrong place.
f1a7b296e1de4514808f.id: Komanya berada di tempat yang salah.

59a95fb62283490ce070.en: The correct spellings are environment, protection and recycle.
59a95fb62283490ce070.id: Ejaan yang benar adalah environment, protection, dan recycle.

1b80a05b2048a8cb5d05.en: Saturday needs a capital, go should be went, monkeys were, and their shows that the babies belong to the monkeys.
1b80a05b2048a8cb5d05.id: Saturday memerlukan huruf kapital, go seharusnya went, monkeys were, dan their menunjukkan bahwa the babies milik the monkeys.

e554e11eae61c08cfd4c.en: Zoo here is a common noun and needs no capital.
e554e11eae61c08cfd4c.id: Di sini zoo adalah kata benda umum (common noun) dan tidak perlu huruf kapital.

071d30c14f041ab1aa88.en: Trees is correct because there are many.
071d30c14f041ab1aa88.id: Trees sudah benar karena jumlahnya banyak.

eda7a3945596a76453aa.en: There was fixes the homophone. Adding so after the comma joins the two sentences correctly.
eda7a3945596a76453aa.id: There was memperbaiki homophone itu. Menambahkan so setelah koma menggabungkan kedua kalimat dengan benar.

39b4a6dcd19c39be9220.en: Their is still the wrong word.

5b42e880031d9c90bb7b.en: The comma still joins two sentences without a joining word.
5b42e880031d9c90bb7b.id: Koma itu masih menyambung dua kalimat tanpa kata hubung.

06798084ed766e891fad.en: They’re means they are and does not fit here.
06798084ed766e891fad.id: They’re berarti they are dan tidak cocok di sini.

a33d2faf60bbbf2d2022.en: Me is correct after for, bought is the past tense of buy, and are agrees with the plural books.
a33d2faf60bbbf2d2022.id: Me benar setelah for, bought adalah past tense dari buy, dan are cocok dengan books yang berbentuk jamak (plural).

1efaecf30fbd3ffddf5b.en: After for, the correct pronoun is me.
1efaecf30fbd3ffddf5b.id: Setelah for, kata ganti (pronoun) yang benar adalah me.

69a77cdef06abeaef41c.en: Books is plural, so the verb should be are.
69a77cdef06abeaef41c.id: Books berbentuk jamak, jadi kata kerjanya seharusnya are.

03e20a524b0c48e6e7da.en: The past tense of buy is bought.
03e20a524b0c48e6e7da.id: Bentuk lampau dari buy adalah bought.

1b397be21d17b5aa3bb2.en: It’s means it is, so It’s a shame is correct. Its (no apostrophe) shows belonging to the dog, so its paw is correct.
1b397be21d17b5aa3bb2.id: It’s berarti it is, jadi It’s a shame itu benar. Its (tanpa apostrof) menunjukkan milik anjing itu, jadi its paw itu benar.

0acd22f5ef595f18caf4.en: The first its should be it’s, meaning it is.
0acd22f5ef595f18caf4.id: Its yang pertama seharusnya it’s, yang berarti it is.

516dfddb279562e05db4.en: The second it’s should be its, meaning belonging to it.
516dfddb279562e05db4.id: It’s yang kedua seharusnya its, yang berarti milik benda itu.

73c054f258a6a65086fa.id: Kalimat ini masih memuat kedua kesalahan itu.

08fab7f7b8d380d0b0e4.en: Children’s is the correct possessive, the playground is singular so is, the comma splice needs a full stop or joining word, and its shows belonging.
08fab7f7b8d380d0b0e4.id: Children’s adalah bentuk kepemilikan yang benar, playground tunggal jadi memakai is, koma yang menyambung dua kalimat (comma splice) perlu diganti titik atau kata penghubung, dan its menunjukkan kepemilikan.

e444c082af93b719d598.en: Which is correct in a non-defining clause.
e444c082af93b719d598.id: Which sudah benar dalam non-defining clause.

52aacf4b6e66a195fe90.en: The park is singular and correct.
52aacf4b6e66a195fe90.id: The park berbentuk tunggal dan sudah benar.

ed883e5762a330a9b64e.en: Apples are countable, so we use fewer. We use less with amounts we cannot count.
ed883e5762a330a9b64e.id: Apples bisa dihitung (countable), jadi kita memakai fewer. Kita memakai less untuk jumlah yang tidak bisa dihitung.

1b4947a8cf2090154891.en: Apples can be counted, so use fewer.
1b4947a8cf2090154891.id: Apples bisa dihitung, jadi pakai fewer.

cb3ec98ab618a18aef6b.en: Much is for things you cannot count.
cb3ec98ab618a18aef6b.id: Much dipakai untuk benda yang tidak bisa dihitung.

ac644532ae0ef9316bf1.en: Little is for things you cannot count.
ac644532ae0ef9316bf1.id: Little dipakai untuk benda yang tidak bisa dihitung.

bb4698f9d57848313b1d.en: Water is uncountable, so we say less water. Biscuits are countable, so we say fewer biscuits.
bb4698f9d57848313b1d.id: Water tidak bisa dihitung (uncountable), jadi kita berkata less water. Biscuits bisa dihitung (countable), jadi kita berkata fewer biscuits.

fe91d4c5a4e0f0a038ca.en: Sugar, traffic and rice are uncountable, so they use less. Coins, mistakes and children are countable, so they use fewer.
fe91d4c5a4e0f0a038ca.id: Sugar, traffic, dan rice tidak bisa dihitung (uncountable), jadi memakai less. Coins, mistakes, dan children bisa dihitung (countable), jadi memakai fewer.

efb17ff6d2dadc175ab4.en: Milk is uncountable, so we say much milk.
efb17ff6d2dadc175ab4.id: Milk tidak bisa dihitung (uncountable), jadi kita berkata much milk.

62b6e1af95d83ad3edaf.en: Milk is uncountable, so use much.
62b6e1af95d83ad3edaf.id: Milk tidak bisa dihitung (uncountable), jadi pakai much.

183e661cb69ba0c5c8ee.id: Few dipakai untuk kata benda yang bisa dihitung (countable).

b5a37b0f97bca513bef9.id: Fewer dipakai untuk kata benda yang bisa dihitung (countable).

1a92d3c668b754d28644.en: Many goes with countable stickers. Less goes with time as an amount.
1a92d3c668b754d28644.id: Many dipakai untuk stickers yang bisa dihitung. Less dipakai untuk time sebagai suatu jumlah.

13ba90c159fd6d6f941a.en: Stickers can be counted, so use many.
13ba90c159fd6d6f941a.id: Stickers bisa dihitung, jadi pakai many.

9532a62c8886ac8ba2bb.en: Time is treated as an amount here, so use less.
9532a62c8886ac8ba2bb.id: Di sini time dianggap sebagai jumlah, jadi pakai less.

ce346e9b9097d5db4997.en: We treat time as an amount, so we say less than ten minutes.
ce346e9b9097d5db4997.id: Kita menganggap waktu sebagai suatu jumlah, jadi kita berkata less than ten minutes.

53fb5972a41bb8f8705e.en: Few than is not correct English.
53fb5972a41bb8f8705e.id: Few than bukan bahasa Inggris yang benar.

652b3a31f73dc762f1af.en: Lesser is not used in this way.

f86015993f677e579e18.en: Sugar is uncountable, so we say less sugar.
f86015993f677e579e18.id: Sugar tidak bisa dihitung (uncountable), jadi kita berkata less sugar.

fe44026b44b194548c3f.en: The verb is fixed but the quantifier is still wrong.
fe44026b44b194548c3f.id: Kata kerjanya sudah diperbaiki, tetapi kata penunjuk jumlahnya masih salah.

9f3002dc5fd426c298ac.en: Fewest is not the right word.

7e6c13abd1cc57b89229.en: Sugars changes the meaning and is still wrong.
7e6c13abd1cc57b89229.id: Sugars mengubah maknanya dan tetap salah.

03f16bbc943a626d9a11.en: You look for spelling, grammar and punctuation errors.
03f16bbc943a626d9a11.id: Kamu mencari kesalahan ejaan, tata bahasa, dan tanda baca.

6fb3dc163b16980a413d.en: There is the correct word here, as in There was a loud noise.
6fb3dc163b16980a413d.id: Kata yang benar di sini adalah There, seperti pada There was a loud noise.

ef25e6a68f1544fe115b.en: Fewer is used for things you can count, such as apples.
ef25e6a68f1544fe115b.id: Fewer dipakai untuk benda yang bisa dihitung, seperti apples.

e7af584ea48190cfc975.en: Reading aloud helps you hear missing words and awkward sentences.
e7af584ea48190cfc975.id: Membaca dengan suara keras membantumu mendengar kata yang hilang dan kalimat yang janggal.

ad79dc3e6efb431214da.en: Who's means who is. The sentence needs whose, which shows belonging.
ad79dc3e6efb431214da.id: Who's berarti who is. Kalimat itu memerlukan whose, yang menunjukkan kepemilikan.

a3e966dd52a244d3829a.en: The correct form is could have gone. Of is not a verb.
a3e966dd52a244d3829a.id: Bentuk yang benar adalah could have gone. Of bukan kata kerja (verb).
